title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions on the Administration of the Use of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Regulations on the Use and Management of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2008] No. 16

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In accordance with the work deployment of the Supreme People's Court on the replacement of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts, the replacement of such certificates by People's Courts at all levels has been completed. To regulate the use and management of Judicial Police Certificates, the Regulations on the Use and Management of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts are hereby issued for your strict compliance and implementation.

May 30, 2008

Regulations on the Use and Management of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts

Article 1 These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the People's Police Law of the People's Republic of China, the Interim Regulations on Judicial Police of People's Courts, and the Regulations on the Use and Management of People's Police Certificates of Public Security Organs, for the purposes of strengthening the standardization of the judicial police force of People's Courts, and regulating and safeguarding the lawful performance of duties by judicial police of People's Courts.

Article 2 Judicial police of People's Courts shall use a unified Judicial Police Certificate. The Judicial Police Certificate is the credential and symbol of the identity of a judicial police officer of a People's Court and of his or her lawful performance of duties.

When lawfully performing duties, unless otherwise provided by laws or regulations, a judicial police officer of a People's Court shall carry the Judicial Police Certificate on his or her person, voluntarily produce it, and indicate his or her identity as a judicial police officer.

Article 3 The scope of issuance of Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts is limited to judicial police officers who are on the roster, active in their posts, and have been assessed and conferred police ranks in the People's Courts. It is strictly prohibited to issue Judicial Police Certificates to persons outside the scope of issuance.

Article 4 The Judicial Police Certificate consists of a special leather case and an inner card. Both components must be complete and used simultaneously for the certificate to be valid.

Article 5 Judicial Police Certificates of People's Courts shall be uniformly produced by the Supreme People's Court. The Judicial Police Certificate shall be replaced by the method of exchanging the old for the new. After the new Judicial Police Certificate is put into use, all previous Judicial Police Certificates shall be rendered void and shall be uniformly recovered and destroyed by the Judicial Police Corps of each High People's Court.

If the key contents recorded on the inner card of the Judicial Police Certificate change and a replacement is indeed necessary, the issuing department shall promptly issue a replacement.

Article 6 Under any of the following circumstances, the People's Court to which a judicial police officer belongs shall promptly recover his or her Judicial Police Certificate:

(1) The officer has retired or is retired;

(2) The officer has been transferred from the judicial police post;

(3) The officer has resigned from public office;

(4) Other circumstances where recovery is necessary.

If a judicial police officer of a People's Court is dismissed, discharged from public office, subjected to re-education through labor, sentenced to criminal punishment, or exempted from criminal punishment, the People's Court to which he or she belongs shall promptly confiscate his or her People's Police Certificate.

Article 7 Under any of the following circumstances, the People's Court to which a judicial police officer belongs shall temporarily recover his or her Judicial Police Certificate:

(1) The officer is under investigation for suspected violation of law or discipline, and a conclusion has not yet been reached;

(2) The officer is suspended from performing duties;

(3) Other circumstances where temporary recovery is necessary.

Article 8 A judicial police officer of a People's Court shall take good care of and properly keep the Judicial Police Certificate, preventing it from being lost, stolen, robbed, or damaged.

If a judicial police officer discovers that his or her Judicial Police Certificate is lost, stolen, robbed, or seriously damaged and cannot be used further, he or she shall promptly report to the People's Court to which he or she belongs and apply for a replacement.

Article 9 A judicial police officer of a People's Court shall not alter, damage, copy, lend, mortgage, give away, or sell the Judicial Police Certificate, nor shall he or she use the Judicial Police Certificate for non-police activities or illegal activities.

If a judicial police officer of a People's Court violates the provisions of the preceding paragraph, he or she shall be subject to disciplinary sanctions or legal liability in accordance with relevant regulations.

Article 10 These Regulations shall take effect as of the date of issuance.
